title: ononis spinosa f. angustifolia
intro: Ononis spinosa f. angustifolia, commonly known as Narrow-leafed Restharrow, is a plant species in the Fabaceae family. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, contributing to the relief of digestive issues, pain, and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Ononis spinosa f. angustifolia include astringent, antispasmodic, and expectorant effects, which help in soothing digestive issues and respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic properties and potential health benefits.
